mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the next 20 days signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly higher than baseline in monetary easing cycles, or 20d returns in non-easing periods are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% within the next 5 days signals labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the following 20 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive despite UNRATE below 4.0% in first 5 days

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP (GDPC1) and household utilization (HOUST) signals robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase AND HOUST increase over 20 days
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive despite both proxies rising over the 20-day horizon

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the next 20 days reflects supply-side growth, supporting equity valuations and returns.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive despite sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the 20-day period

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in federal funds rate above 4.5% over the next 20 days signals aggressive tightening, raising borrowing costs and pressuring equity markets.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative despite FEDFUNDS above 4.5% over the 20-day window

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over 60 days amplifies labor market confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60d returns not positive despite UNRATE decline in late-cycle regime

mechanism_narrative: Growth in GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) simultaneously signal robust demand, boosting corporate profits and equity returns over the next 20 days.

failure_condition: 20d returns not positive despite both proxies (GDPC1 and RSAFS) rising over the 20-day horizon
